title: MLBComp — Auditable MLB Research & Paper Competition
description: Auditable MLB research and paper-betting platform running the loop research -> discover -> verify -> model -> backtest -> forward-test -> paper trade -> analyze -> improve, with no bookmaker, exchange or order-placement client anywhere in the repository. It separates REG, POST, WC, DS, LCS and WS environments (ALL is a roll-up view, not a blended score), carries a 90-entry versioned research catalog spanning baselines, starting pitchers, bullpens, lineups/injuries, Statcast, pitch mix, park/weather, umpires, rest/travel, market movement, totals, first-five, run line, team/player props, live, futures, exchange and prediction-market hypotheses, and keeps an append-only SHA-256 hash-chained ledger protected by SQLite UPDATE and DELETE triggers. A source snapshot is loaded via content-addressed api.github.com git-blob fetches, so the checkout publishes data_mode SOURCE_SNAPSHOT: 28,072 tracked games of which 27,972 are completed, 91 upcoming and 9 incomplete, with 154,688 bet records in the database, 33,143 of them settled and mirrored into the immutable ledger (20,000 rows exported for page size), 48,336 quote rows and 221,538 predictions. THE HEADLINE FACT CHANGED THIS PASS: settled_bets is no longer 0 and total_simulated_pnl is no longer null — they now read 33,143 and -$96,903.05, because the gate that requires a verified timestamped quote has since been satisfied by the bettingtools and cesar-dx historical moneyline files; the audit control no_unverified_pnl still reports 0 unverified bet rows with non-zero PnL, so every one of those 33,143 settlements carries a verified price. The odds source it did find is still recorded as PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and still ineligible for wager eligibility specifically because cesar-dx MLB betting ML carries no observed_at / available_at timestamps — its own notes say moneyline rows are join-verified to the schedule by game_pk/date/teams but 'prices stay UNVERIFIED for wager eligibility'. All 22 adversarial audit controls pass, against 18 at the previous read; the README's own rebuild note still says 18 and is flagged as stale (IRR-98).
